sections.heading: Overview
content: According to the Centers for Medicare & Medicaid Services (CMS), assistant at surgery services are those services rendered by physicians or nonphysician practitioners (NPPs) who actively assist the physician in charge of performing a surgical procedure.

sections.heading: Medicare Advantage Payment Policy
content: In addition to the policy, claims payments are subject to other plan requirements for the processing and payment of claims, including, but not limited to, requirements of medical necessity and reasonableness and applicable referral or authorization requirements.

subsections.heading: Coverage
content: Original Medicare (OM) covers an assistant at surgery service provided by a physician, with some exclusions, or an NPP. A charge for an assistant at surgery service provided by another individual is not payable. Therefore, a Humana Medicare Advantage (MA) plan denies, to provider liability, a charge for an assistant at surgery service submitted by an individual whose service would not be coverable for an enrollee of OM. Humana uses the Medicare Physician Fee Schedule (MPFS) Relative Value File assistant at surgery indicator to determine if an assistant at surgery is medically necessary and, therefore, covered. When the MPFS Relative Value File is not definitive, then Humana’s internal criteria are used.

subsections.heading: Assistant at Surgery in a Teaching Hospital
content: Humana determines coverage of a charge submitted by an assistant at surgery in a teaching hospital consistent with the qualifications required by CMS for an OM enrollee.

subsections.heading: Billing
content: Only one of the following modifiers should be billed per charge: AS, 80, 81 or 82 . An assistant at surgery should bill the same procedure code as the primary surgeon and the appropriate assistant at surgery modifier, except when billing for assistance during a cesarean delivery. When billing for assistance only during a cesarean delivery, the assistant at surgery should bill Current Procedural Terminology (CPT®) code 59514 (cesarean delivery only) or CPT code 59620 (c esarean delivery only, following attempted vaginal delivery after previous cesarean delivery) and the appropriate assistant at surgery modifier. Humana will not reimburse a practitioner who acts as an assistant at surgery in a cesarean delivery any more than the assistant at surgery rate that would apply for the CPT code appropriate for delivery only.

subsections.heading: Reimbursement
content: A Humana MA plan allows an assistant at surgery physician charge, indicated by modifier 80, 81 or 82, at 16 percent of the contracted rate or base maximum amount payable under the member’s plan , subject to any other applicable reductions, for a service considered medically necessary. A Humana MA plan allows an assistant at surgery NPP charge, indicated by modifier AS , at 16 percent of the contracted rate or base maximum amount payable under the member’s plan appropriate for the NPP, subject to any other applicable reductions, for a service considered medically necessary.

subsections.heading: Contracted Providers
content: Physician: The amount allowed is 16 percent of the provider's contracted rate, subject to other applicable adjustments. NPP: The amount allowed is 16 percent of the provider's contracted rate, subject to other applicable adjustments.

subsections.heading: Noncontracted Providers
content: Physician: The amount allowed is 16 percent of 100 percent of the MPFS amount for the service, subject to other applicable adjustments. NPP: The amount allowed is 16 percent of 85 percent (13.6 percent) of the MPFS amount for the service, subject to other applicable adjustments.

sections.heading: Definitions of Italicized Terms
content: • Base maximum amount payable under the member’s plan: The maximum amount of reimbursement for a covered expense, determined by the member’s plan. Depending on the plan, this may be the maximum allowable fee, the appropriate Medicare fee schedule rate or an amount derived from another payment model. Actual plan reimbursement may be less than this base maximum amount, because of applicable adjustments. • CPT code 59514: Cesarean delivery only. • CPT code 59620: C esarean delivery only, following attempted vaginal delivery after previous cesarean delivery. • Maximum allowable fee (MAF): The maximum amount of reimbursement for a covered expense, determined by the member’s plan provisions. Actual plan payment may be less than MAF, because of applicable adjustments. • Medicare Physician Fee Schedule (MPFS) Relative Value File: A file published by the Centers for Medicare & Medicaid Services that includes, among other information, assistant at surgery indicator, relative value units and conversion factors for physician

services. This file is commonly referred to as the relative value unit (RVU) table. • Modifier 80: Assistant surgeon. • Modifier 81: Minimum assistant surgeon. • Modifier 82: Assistant surgeon (when qualified resident surgeon not available). • Modifier AS: Physician assistant, nurse practitioner, or clinical nurse specialist services for assistant at surgery.
